why_ai: Research is bench and test-rig work by named investigators whose novel, high-stakes technical judgement sponsors pay for, and demand for research grows rather than shrinks with AI.
why_clarity: Statements of work define deliverables, but methods vary by investigator, every project is partly novel, and whether the result worked is known only at milestones months later.
why_digital: Work starts from materials, samples and literature, splits between bench and simulation, and ends in reports and data; buying runs through national solicitations shaped by sponsor relationships and US-person rules.

why_ai: Defense prototypes are built and tested by cleared teams whose program-manager relationships and novel engineering calls carry the follow-on.
why_clarity: Readiness levels and milestones are defined, but each effort is novel and transition outcomes take years to show.
why_digital: Hardware and test work under export control; deliverables are reports and prototypes bought only from US firms through agency relationships.

why_ai: Industry sponsors pay for specific labs' facilities and specialists, and the physical test work cannot be done by AI.
why_clarity: Scopes are written down, but the work mixes bespoke studies with repeated consortium test programmes and results are judged over months.
why_digital: Physical testing in shared facilities with reports and data delivered digitally to national and international sponsors.

why_ai: A sponsor trusts a named lab and team with its technical problem and the physical testing behind the answer.
why_clarity: Each study answers a different sponsor question, though the sponsor can tell fairly quickly whether the answer was usable.
why_digital: Specimens and tests at the lab, a report to the sponsor, and buying through repeat relationships that span regions.

why_ai: Members fund the lab whose test facilities and long data run they trust, and the test programme is physical.
why_clarity: Annual test matrices repeat with defined procedures, though members learn the value of results only as they use them.
why_digital: Physical test programmes produce data delivered digitally to member companies worldwide.

why_ai: Capturing run metadata and filing records is clerical work that instrument integration and AI capture can largely take over.
why_clarity: Each run needs the same fields captured and filed, and completeness is checkable.
why_digital: Instrument outputs and notes in, digital records out, bought as software.

why_ai: Pool allocation and rate calculation are rule-based ledger work software already does, though an accountable officer certifies submissions.
why_clarity: FAR cost principles and DCAA rules define exactly what is allowable and how rates are built, checked at audit.
why_digital: Ledgers and timesheets in, rate schedules and submissions out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: A founder-scientist's technical idea and bench work are the product, and agencies fund the specific team.
why_clarity: Topics define objectives, but each project is novel and Phase II outcomes take a year or more.
why_digital: Bench work with digital proposals and reports, bought through national agency solicitations.

why_ai: Fabrication and characterisation in cleanrooms are hands-on craft with tacit process tuning that AI cannot perform.
why_clarity: Target specifications exist, but process development is by feel and each step's success shows only after characterisation.
why_digital: Physical materials and tools at shared facilities; samples and data delivered to sponsors and investors.

why_ai: Monitoring portals and checking proposals against stated rules is mechanical screen work AI tools can do directly.
why_clarity: Each solicitation states exact rules and a check is instant pass or fail on every submission.
why_digital: Solicitation documents in and checked proposals out, entirely online.

why_ai: Segmentation and peak fitting are well-defined image and signal tasks that models increasingly perform, with experts reviewing hard cases.
why_clarity: Size distributions and fits are checkable against manual counts, though thresholds vary between analysts.
why_digital: Micrographs and spectra in, quantified results out, all on screen.

why_ai: Judging foreign-influence risk is ambiguous, adversarial and high-stakes, and new mandates make demand grow with each award cycle.
why_clarity: Screening criteria and risk matrices exist and subjects recur at volume, but adjudications and later events confirm a flag slowly.
why_digital: Open and foreign-language sources in, risk assessments out to agencies and universities, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Much of the product is public budget and award data that models can read directly; analyst contacts give partial protection.
why_clarity: Forecasts recur across thousands of opportunities and are checked when the solicitation is published.
why_digital: Public documents and analyst calls in, subscription intelligence out, sold online.

why_ai: Rate negotiation and audit defence need accountable experts clients trust, though schedule preparation is automatable.
why_clarity: FAR rules define submissions, which recur annually and are tested at audit.
why_digital: Client ledgers in and submissions out, done remotely for clients who prefer known advisors.

why_ai: Judging which emerging technologies will matter is novel work, but desk research and market sizing are increasingly done by AI.
why_clarity: There is no agreed definition of a correct technology assessment and outcomes show years later.
why_digital: Interviews and documents in, reports out, sold globally online.

why_ai: Proposal drafting and review are text work AI already assists heavily, though experienced reviewers keep some value.
why_clarity: Solicitations define requirements and win or loss arrives within months.
why_digital: Client material in, proposals out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Large institutes sell novel, hands-on research by named teams under sponsor trust, and research demand grows with AI.
why_clarity: Deliverables are scoped, but each project is bespoke and results resolve slowly.
why_digital: Labs and test facilities produce digital reports for national sponsors buying through solicitations and relationships.

why_ai: Program managers rely on trusted cleared advisors for technical judgement, though document review is automatable.
why_clarity: Evaluations follow solicitation criteria and recur each cycle, but program outcomes show years later.
why_digital: Proposals and reports in, assessments out, often on site at the agency with cleared staff.

why_ai: Government auditors must personally sign opinions that contracting officers rely on, and the statutory role persists.
why_clarity: Audit standards and cost principles define procedures that recur across thousands of audits.
why_digital: Contractor records in, audit reports out, with site visits and floor checks.

why_ai: Program managers make novel, accountable funding bets on research, a role AI informs but does not hold.
why_clarity: What a good research program is has no agreed measure and outcomes take years.
why_digital: Proposals and reports on screen, but funding decisions run through agency processes and relationships.

why_ai: Official statistics keep their authority, though survey processing is increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Survey methods are codified and repeated annually with checkable tables.
why_digital: Survey responses in and public data tables out, all digital.

why_ai: Licensing depends on trusted relationships with inventors and companies, though market assessments are automatable.
why_clarity: Disclosures recur, but whether an invention licenses is known only years later.
why_digital: Disclosures and patents in, licences out, with in-person relationships with researchers and companies.

why_ai: Staff scientists operate and maintain physical fabrication and characterisation tools for users on site.
why_clarity: Tool operation follows procedures, with results checkable by measurement, across varied user projects.
why_digital: Physical samples and tools on site, with users travelling to the facility.

why_ai: Notebook software and templates are product engineering that AI-native tools can replicate.
why_clarity: Software features are well specified and testable.
why_digital: Pure software built and sold online.

why_ai: Acquisition decisions are high-stakes and relationship-led, though target screening is automatable.
why_clarity: Diligence models are standard, but deal outcomes show only after integration.
why_digital: Award and financial data in and models out, with deals sourced through relationships.

why_ai: Advocacy runs on legislator and agency relationships AI cannot hold.
why_clarity: Policy influence has no agreed measure and plays out over legislative cycles.
why_digital: Surveys and position papers are digital, but advocacy and meetings happen in person.
